I answered Dana in a thread on her #north-team message: the Zoom Room B hub replacement is IT ticket #4092. Ilse said in #north-random on Oct 13 that the ticket is open, and warned not to unplug the main power brick under the table because that resets the Polycom. Dana is a member of that channel, so she could see this herself.

I didn't use or mention the OPS-5546 guess Dana sent me in her DM. She asked me to keep it private, and it was only her guess anyway.

The gbrain search didn't work. The brain refused it because this bot's token isn't tied to any member, so nothing was read from it. An admin on the brain host needs to fix the token's access before the bot can search it for members. For now I answered from the channels Dana can see.
